description: Writes a short, polite message a buyer can send a signal seller (Discord, Telegram, X, email) asking them to lock their next calls on Aevum before the buyer pays, so wins and losses both end up on a record anyone can check. Nothing is sent or stored; return the text for the person to copy.

calls.description: How many upcoming calls to ask for (default 3; each wallet can lock 3 per 30 days, so 5 or 10 take months)

name: prove_it_message
title: Ask a signal seller for proof
